definitions.explanation: Traditional medicine based on Chinese medical theory, using natural ingredients such as herbs, roots, and minerals. In Japan, kampo is integrated into the modern healthcare system and prescribed by regular doctors alongside Western medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漢方薬|かんぽうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I took herbal medicine for my cold.

examples.english: Since Western medicine didn't agree with me, my doctor recommended I try kampo.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Unlike in many Western countries, {漢方薬|かんぽうやく} is part of mainstream medicine in Japan. Regular doctors can prescribe kampo, and many formulations are covered by national health insurance. Common prescriptions include {葛根湯|かっこんとう} (for colds) and {芍薬甘草湯|しゃくやくかんぞうとう} (for muscle cramps).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漢方薬|かんぽうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to take herbal medicine)
- {漢方薬|かんぽうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prescribe kampo)
- {漢方薬局|かんぽうやっきょく} (kampo pharmacy)
- ⟦{漢方|かんぽう}→漢方：13397_kanpou⟧⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧ (kampo medicine — the discipline)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {西洋薬|せいようやく}: Western medicine — conventional pharmaceuticals
- ⟦{生薬|しょうやく}→生薬：18117_shouyaku⟧: crude drug — the individual natural ingredients used in kampo
